briefing.geography: One long rail line crosses a deep river gorge between defended approaches.
goals: Build on both approaches and survive through wave 12.
Trestle Crossing: see the ore cart safely over the gorge.
rules: The trestle is the only easy crossing over deep water.
Rail Toughs and Steam Wreckers press both approaches.
The south bank beside the base remains open for sluice work.
Coal seams lie along the mine spur on the south approach, west of the boiler site.

buildables.meaning: Lights the dark and slows what it touches; radius 8wu.
Timber that holds. Bandits break it before you.
Works the river for you: 3g per cycle beside water.
Holds +150 gold above the pan cap.
Spark bolts, line-of-sight, 16wu range.
Write orders; the town's craftsmen answer. One per claim.
Feeds coal into the Steamworks pressure line.
